title: Working next to the Z machine at Sandia

tellings.quote: I used to work uh next to the Z machine at Sandia.

plain: He used to work right next to the Z machine at Sandia National Laboratories, a US government research lab in New Mexico, says John Brandenburg, a scientist who argues that Mars once had life that was wiped out by nuclear war. The Z machine is a huge device there that releases enormous bursts of electrical power, and he mentions it in passing as part of his own working background.
